description: Plan an epic's parallelism (the pairwise collision matrix, waves and fronts, merge grid, machine-readable YAML — one numbered question at a time), approve it, then execute it: [E] hands over to waves-core-parallelism and the session becomes the master.
Launch a run (LLM orchestration by default, deterministic on request), resume a paused one, arm the watchers, open the TUI; step-by-step questions with defaults, or [P] to take every default.
Install or update the Riaworks Waves module config and help entries.
Read-only triage of the deferred-work ledger into a machine-readable partition. Automation-only; waves sweep invokes it.

Write this project's provisioning recipe — the stack every unit of a run works against: a database of its own, its environment file, its services on their own ports — as scripts/waves-front.sh plus the [scm] provision / teardown keys, and leave a consult skill for the sessions; one numbered question at a time.

Write this project's tests config — how each kind of test runs, what type it is, how many fronts may run it at once, and whether a story runs what it touched or the whole suite — in _waves/tests_memory.toml, tried on one test per kind; the waves runs then gate each story with one command and queue each type of test instead of guessing a scope. One numbered question at a time.

The map of every file the waves runs read — the loop policy (adapters per role: CLI, model, effort), the tests config, the provisioning recipe, the skills' customizations, the watcher's rules — with its state and the door that owns each; configures what has no door of its own and hands the rest to waves-tests, waves-provisioning or the settings screen. One numbered question at a time; [D] diagnoses only.
